I played DnD a lot with many awesome people back in the 80s it seems like the best thing you can do is to pick a character you want to be, and then guide it according to your own ethics and beliefs.

Ideally you'd want to find someone who's played before to dungeon master for your group of new guys (which you must assemble). Otherwise you can be the dungeon master and play with some friends. If you are the DM (Dungeon Master) then you need to start reading the rules and understand them better than your players. As for the actual game, I'd recommend a bunch of friends who are interested to come over for a sleepover and you guys order pizza whilst playing.
